'''Polis Massan bodysuits''' were form-fitting protective bodysuits worn by members of the [[Kallidahin/Legends|Polis Massan]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The suits held a number of pockets and were each equipped with a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
